text: One of the best habit and task management apps ever released. It's a true evolution of Habitica, featuring a deep and engaging gamification system. Although it's still in its early stages (of launch), it's already very complete and even includes a web version, which is essential for anyone who wants to use it as their daily task manager. I highly recommend it!
